    Healthcare Degrees, Certificates & CEUs

    Ready to start your healthcare degree program?

    Nebraska Methodist College is among the top nursing and allied healthcare colleges in the nation.

    Whether you're pursuing a nursing degree or a career in allied health or other health professions, NMC is the healthcare college for you. That's because healthcare education is our only focus. We help you realize your educational goals through a supportive student environment, expert faculty committed to your success and a cutting-edge education, on campus and online.

     • Alumni practicing in 39 of 50 U.S. states and territories
     • 100% pass rates across all Allied Health programs
     • In-person, online and hybrid programs
     • All graduate programs designed for working students

    When I was young, I would often accompany my Spanish speaking parents to medical appointments to interpret for them. So many times they’d have to wait longer to be taken care of. The care they received wasn’t always equitable. When I think about NMC, I recognize the many ways that the faculty, staff and the college community have fueled my desire to learn and grow and keep going even when things seemed incredibly hard

    Deisy H.

    BSN Student

    • 14:1

    • 91%

    I chose NMC because of my involvement in the Upward Bound Program while I was in high school. Every time I visited, I fell in love with the school. The NMC staff always had something positive to say. I love that I do not have to be afraid to ask questions and that I feel safe to study anywhere in the school that I wish.

    Dalliya C.

    Respiratory Therapy Student
